description: Implementation of TransactionService handling payment transactions, including methods for creating, listing, and retrieving specific transactions by order and type.

classes.name: TransactionServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for managing payment transactions, providing features like creation, retrieval, and processing transactions related to orders.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new transaction, serializing its details to JSON before saving.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions associated with a specific order, parsing JSON details into a map.

methods.name: getCapturableTransaction
methods.description: Finds a transaction suitable for capture, typically one that was authorized but not yet captured or refunded.

methods.name: getRefundableTransaction
methods.description: Identifies the most recent transaction eligible for a refund, considering various transaction types and timestamps.
